role: Declares chunk generation ahead of the step (genahead.c): the batch generator interface (struct ga_gen, the C stand-in and the CUDA one), the per-environment cache, the step, hints, the statistics and the report.
notes: ga_gen_cuda_create is defined by csrc/cuda/worldgen/ahead.c, linked only into out/native/cuda/worldgen/test_snapshots. lane/genphase: the step in two halves (genahead_predict; genahead_fill, and genahead_fill_raw, which keeps a result by reference and constructs its chunk when the tick takes it) for csrc/runtime/pool.c device generation; a dead player respawn square is predicted; ga_gen_cuda_local_create (csrc/cuda/worldgen/ahead.c) runs the generators in the calling process.
